How DentOS Was Built

Built After Sitting Inside
Real Clinics

We didn't build DentOS from a boardroom. We built it from inside working dental clinics — watching, listening, and documenting every friction point.

🏥
Step 01
We Visited Clinics
Not to pitch — to observe. We spent days inside dental clinics across India, sitting at reception desks, watching consultations, understanding how teams actually work.
Multiple clinics visited before writing code
👁️
Step 02
We Observed Real Workflows
We mapped every step — how appointments are booked, how patient history is stored, how notes are written during consultations, how follow-ups are remembered (or forgotten).
Dozens of hours of workflow observation
💬
Step 03
We Talked To Everyone
Dentists. Receptionists. Clinic managers. We asked: what breaks every day? What takes too long? What do you wish software could just handle? The answers were consistent.
Interviews across doctors, receptionists & managers
🔍
Step 04
We Found The Real Problems
WhatsApp chaos. Missed follow-ups. Documentation overhead. Scattered records. Not software problems — workflow problems. DentOS was designed to solve the workflow first.
5 core operational bottlenecks identified
⚡
Step 05
We Built It. And Keep Improving It.
Every feature maps to a real problem we witnessed. And we're still in clinics — every week, real feedback shapes what gets built next. This isn't finished software. It gets better every week.
Weekly updates driven by real feedback

Questions

Every Question
Clinic Owners Ask First

Why not just keep using WhatsApp? +
WhatsApp works — until it doesn't. It has no patient history, no follow-up tracking, no billing, no clinical notes, and no audit trail. When your receptionist is sick, the clinic's institutional memory disappears with her. DentOS means your clinic runs on a system, not a person's phone.
How long does onboarding take? +
The founder gets on a call with you personally. 45 minutes. They configure DentOS around your specific workflow, walks your team through everything, and stays available on WhatsApp for the first 30 days. Most clinics are fully operational the same day.
Will my receptionist actually learn it? +
Yes — and faster than you think. DentOS is designed to be intuitive without training manuals. Most receptionists are comfortable with the day-to-day flow within a few hours. The interface is simple because complexity kills adoption.
What happens if I need support? +
You WhatsApp the founder directly — +91 96236 26993. Not a support ticket. Not a call centre. The person who built this. Your problems become the next week's priority fixes.
Can I migrate my existing patient data? +
Yes. Our team helps you import existing records from whatever system you're currently using — whether that's another software, spreadsheets, or even handwritten files that have been photographed. You won't lose historical data.
How secure is patient information? +
All patient data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We follow industry-standard security practices, do not share data with third parties, and run automatic daily backups. Your patient data belongs to your clinic — always.
Does it work on tablets? +
Yes. DentOS is fully responsive and works beautifully on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers. Most dentists keep a tablet chairside for voice notes and patient record access during consultations. No app download required.
